caption: The drawing consists of five illustrated busts of women arranged in a triangular composition on a plain, beige background. At the top left, a woman with pale skin and round cheeks has short dark hair styled with a wide blue headband, blue earmuffs, and a necklace of pink beads. To her right, a profile of a similarly styled woman features the same blue headband and earmuffs, but her hair is covered with a gold net and she also wears a pink beaded necklace. In the center, a woman with light skin and blond hair, styled in braids coiled at the back, is shown in three-quarter view; she wears a double-strand lavender beaded necklace and matching earrings. On the bottom left, a profile of a light-skinned woman displays a soft updo decorated with pink ribbons, yellow floral earrings, and a wide golden bead necklace with a pink bow at the back. On the bottom right, a front-facing woman with pale skin has grayish, tightly curled hair decorated with pink bows, yellow floral earrings, and a similar golden bead necklace with pink trim. The drawings are rendered in colored pencil or watercolor with soft shading and distinct, clean outlines. The artist’s signature, "Eugene Croce," is at the bottom right.
title: Three Dolls
